technical.summary: RTX shows solid momentum with multiple bullish MA alignments and rising RSI/Stochastic indicators, but weak ADX trend strength and bearish Hull MA divergence limit conviction for high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: Insufficient signal data with no detectable insider or institutional activity; 91 days to earnings provides adequate timing buffer but overall conviction remains indeterminate.

sentiment.summary: Broad market sentiment is a headwind with fear-driven conditions presenting contrarian buying opportunity; no congressional signals available to confirm or contradict technical setup.

risk.summary: Elevated VIX at 31.2 combined with imminent FOMC decision in 1 day creates excessive event risk; unfavourable conditions for new swing trade entry.

debate.key_bull_argument: RTX displays strong technical momentum with price above all major moving averages, rising RSI across multiple timeframes, and bullish stochastic cross, supported by contrarian sentiment opportunity in fear-driven market conditions.
debate.key_bear_argument: Imminent FOMC decision in 1 day combined with elevated VIX (31.2) creates excessive event risk that outweighs moderate technical setup; weak trend strength (ADX 20.17), bearish Hull MA divergence, and lack of confirmed strategy triggers reduce entry quality despite bullish price action.

decision.entry_rationale: Imminent FOMC decision (1 day) with elevated VIX 31.2 creates unacceptable event risk that negates moderate technical momentum despite bullish price structure.
decision.primary_risk: FOMC announcement tomorrow will likely trigger significant volatility and gap movement, invalidating technical setup and stop-loss levels.
